e.summary_en: The BIS institute for supervisory capacity building: training and publications for financial-sector supervisors, under the Bank for International Settlements

e.summary: 国际清算银行下属的监管能力建设机构：面向金融业监管者的培训与出版系列，覆盖银行、保险等监管议题
e.body:
**FSI（Financial Stability Institute，金融稳定学院）** 是**国际清算银行（BIS）下设的监管能力建设机构**——面向各国**金融业监管者**提供培训、技术援助与出版。本条目属本轮**监管能力建设**取向——实测池内 **Toronto Centre 0（且 403）、FSI 相关条目 0**（仅有两处无关误命中）。这一形态与同批的 [[a2ii]]（普惠保险监管倡议）互补：**A2ii 聚焦普惠保险，FSI 覆盖整体审慎监管议题**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **关于页 `/fsi/about.htm`（168.2KB）**，页面标题实测为 **「Financial Stability Institute | Bank for International Settlements」**；⭐ **出版系列页 `/fsi/publications.htm`（178.1KB）**；站点位于 **BIS 域名之下**（`bis.org`，其顶层导航实测含 **About／Research & publications／Committees／Speeches／Statistics／Media & events**，即 FSI 是**BIS 整体研究出版体系的一部分**）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「监管者能力建设」这一形态**——池内监管侧条目多为**监管机构本身的统计与规则**（[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[fsca]]、[[dnb]] 等），而 **FSI 补的是「监管者自己被培训与研究支持」这一层**；对做**监管比较、监管有效性、保险监管能力**方向的学生，**FSI 的出版系列是把「监管实践」写成可引用文本的地方**，且**常覆盖新兴市场的能力差距议题**。**② 与 [[a2ii]]、[[iais-icp]] 形成完整监管知识链**——**IAIS 定原则（[[iais-icp]]、[[iais-gimar]]）→ FSI 做能力建设（本条）→ A2ii 做普惠保险监管专项（[[a2ii]]）**，三者层次分明；**③ BIS 的统计与研究体系可顺带使用**（BIS 相关统计入口本轮未单独收录，但 FSI 页面处于同一站点体系，读者可自然扩展到 BIS 的统计栏目）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**关于页与出版系列页的存在、标题与页面体量**，**但未打开任何 FSI 出版物**，因此**不能描述其具体系列（如 FSI Insights 等）与最新期次**；**②** `bis.org/fsi/`（无文件名的路径）实测 **404**，**故词条只给已核实的 `/fsi/about.htm` 与 `/fsi/publications.htm`**；**③** FSI 的**培训项目的参与条件（是否面向所有监管者、是否有名额限制）本次未核实**；**④** 本条**只写 FSI**，**未把 BIS 的银行业统计打包进来**（避免越界描述）。**核实说明**：`/fsi/about.htm`（168.2KB）、`/fsi/publications.htm`（178.1KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取标题；`/fsi/` 实测 404 已如实记录；**未打开任何 FSI 出版物**。
e.body_en:
**The FSI (Financial Stability Institute)** is **the supervisory capacity-building institute of the Bank for International Settlements**, providing training, technical assistance and publications for **financial-sector supervisors** worldwide. This entry follows this round’s **supervisory capacity building** direction — a measured search found **Toronto Centre at 0 (and returning 403) and FSI-related entries at 0** (only two unrelated matches). The form complements [[a2ii]] (the inclusive-insurance supervisory initiative) added earlier: **A2ii focuses on inclusive insurance, the FSI spans the broader prudential agenda**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **about page `/fsi/about.htm` (168.2KB)** with the **measured title "Financial Stability Institute | Bank for International Settlements"**; ⭐ the **publications page `/fsi/publications.htm` (178.1KB)**; the institute sits **under the BIS domain** (`bis.org`, whose top-level navigation shows **About / Research & publications / Committees / Speeches / Statistics / Media & events**, i.e. the FSI is **part of the BIS research and publication system**).

For RIAA: **① it adds the "supervisory capacity building" form** — corpus entries on the regulatory side are mostly **regulators’ own statistics and rules** ([[naic-financial-data-repository]], [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[apra-insurance-statistics]], [[fsca]], [[dnb]] and others), while **the FSI adds the layer where supervisors themselves are trained and supported by research**; for students working on **regulatory comparison, supervisory effectiveness or insurance supervisory capacity**, **the FSI publication series is where supervisory practice is written up in citable form**, and it **frequently addresses capacity gaps in emerging markets**. **② With [[a2ii]] and [[iais-icp]] it forms a complete supervisory knowledge chain** — **the IAIS sets principles ([[iais-icp]], [[iais-gimar]]) → the FSI builds capacity (this entry) → A2ii handles inclusive-insurance supervision ([[a2ii]])** — three clearly layered roles; **③ the wider BIS statistical and research system is then within reach** (BIS statistics were not separately entered this round, but FSI pages sit in the same site, so readers can extend naturally to the BIS statistics section).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the existence, titles and page sizes of the about and publications pages**, **but opened no FSI publication**, so **its specific series (such as FSI Insights) and latest editions cannot be described**; **②** the path `bis.org/fsi/` (without a file name) measured **404**, so **this entry gives only the verified `/fsi/about.htm` and `/fsi/publications.htm`**; **③** the **participation conditions for FSI training (whether open to all supervisors, whether places are limited) were not verified**; **④** this entry covers **the FSI only** and **does not package in the BIS banking statistics** (avoiding out-of-scope description). **Verification note**: `/fsi/about.htm` (168.2KB) and `/fsi/publications.htm` (178.1KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles read; `/fsi/` measured 404 and is recorded; **no FSI publication was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**FSI（Financial Stability Institute，金融穩定學院）** 是**國際清算銀行（BIS）下設的監管能力建設機構**，面向各國**金融業監管者**提供培訓、技術援助與出版。本條目屬本輪**監管能力建設**取向——實測池內 **Toronto Centre 0（且 403）、FSI 相關條目 0**。此形態與同批 [[a2ii]] 互補：**A2ii 聚焦普惠保險，FSI 覆蓋整體審慎監管議題**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **關於頁（168.2KB）**，標題實測為 **「Financial Stability Institute | Bank for International Settlements」**；⭐ **出版系列頁（178.1KB）**；站點位於 **BIS 域名之下**（頂層導航含 About／Research & publications／Committees／Speeches／Statistics／Media & events）。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「監管者能力建設」這一形態**——池內監管側多為**監管機構自身的統計與規則**，而 **FSI 補的是「監管者自己被培訓與研究支持」這一層**；**② 與 [[a2ii]]、[[iais-icp]] 形成完整監管知識鏈**——**IAIS 定原則 → FSI 做能力建設 → A2ii 做普惠保險監管專項**；**③ BIS 統計與研究體系可順帶使用**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**兩頁的存在、標題與體量**，**但未打開任何 FSI 出版物**，故**不能描述其具體系列與最新期次**；**② `bis.org/fsi/` 實測 404**，**故只給已核實的兩個路徑**；**③ 培訓參與條件未核實**；**④ 本條只寫 FSI**，**未把 BIS 銀行業統計打包進來**。**核實說明**：兩頁 HTTP 200 實測；`/fsi/` 404 已記錄；**未打開任何 FSI 出版物**。
